proves.claim: The real list with list.thinRead on holds the list thin startup row, judged by child CPU time.

cli.io-list-thin.startup-row-holds.why: Without it, the list thin startup row would be measured only inside the shared read-startup file and a loaded run there could hide or blame it.

proves.claim: The version, show, status and list rows hold their startup rows.

cli.io-commands-read-startup.the-version.why: Without it, the four rows that stay in read-startup.test.js would go unmeasured once list thin moved out.
